job.rawJd: Körber is hiring a Strategic Account Manager in the United States. The role drives strategic account strategies and is the lead point of contact for customer account management matters. Responsibilities include developing global account strategies for Pharma, Biotech, and Cell & Gene customers; managing the central customer relationship, satisfaction, steering, escalations, and contract matters; creating and quantifying value solutions with Product Management; consulting customers on global MES programs; reporting account progress and business objectives to executive management; advancing the Strategic Account Management methodology; communicating monthly and quarterly initiative progress; collaborating with internal and external resources; and forecasting and tracking account metrics. Required experience includes a strong MES sales record, five to ten years of sales experience, precise communication from department to C-Level, decision influence and negotiation, matrix and global-team collaboration, short-term and strategic planning, organization in a fast-paced environment, regulated-industry IT project delivery, travel to customer and corporate sites, CRM software, and Microsoft Office. IPMA or PMP certification is a plus. Körber Business Area Pharma provides MES software, including Werum PAS-X, to pharmaceutical and biotech manufacturers.
